title: A deployed shell without --env hears B0785, not B0762
why: Without --env the lookup reads the development section, so a variable set under [production] was reported as missing. `brain analytics` could also act on a production database without stating the environment.
changelog: stop with B0785 instead of B0762 about a variable set under `[production]`
B0762 names `[production]` when `DATABASE_URL` is only set there
